user.title: Kaleidescape Voice
user.description: Enter the two Kaleidescape components. These are different machines: the player takes playback commands, the server hosts the movie library.

data_description.player_host: The player that drives your screen. Control protocol on TCP port 10000.
data_description.server_host: The server that stores your movies. Its library is read over HTTP.

error.cannot_connect_player: No Kaleidescape player answered on port 10000 at that address. Check the IP, and make sure this is the player and not the movie server.
error.cannot_read_library: Could not read the movie library from that address. Check the IP, and make sure this is the movie server and not the player.

abort.already_configured: This Kaleidescape system is already set up.

init.title: Routing and fallback
init.description: Optional. The activity gate lets bare commands like "pause" reach the Kaleidescape only while the remote is on the Kaleidescape activity.

data_description.activity_state: The exact state value, for example "Watch Kaleidescape".
data_description.api_key: Enables descriptive requests like "the one where the president fights terrorists on a plane". Uses Claude Haiku 4.5 (~$0.013 per query, and only for requests a title match cannot answer). Leave empty to stay fully local.

play_movie.name: Play movie
play_movie.description: Play a movie by approximate title or exact handle.

search.name: Search library
search.description: Search title, cast, director, genres and synopsis; returns the matches.

query.name: Query
query.description: Franchise, actor, genre or partial title.

play_result.name: Play search result
play_result.description: Play the Nth result of the last search.

index.name: Index
index.description: Position in the last result list, from 1.

send_command.name: Send raw command
send_command.description: Send a raw control-protocol command to the player.
